entries.headline: Chairman Selig calls IL crypto tax a 'sin tax on blockchain'
entries.summary: CFTC Chair Michael Selig published an op-ed in the Washington Times calling the Illinois Digital Asset Tax Act a 'sin tax' that risks Chicago's financial legacy.

entries.headline: Rep. Cabello files HB 5798 to repeal the Digital Asset Tax
entries.summary: State Rep. John Cabello (R-Machesney Park) filed House Bill 5798 for immediate repeal of the 0.2% digital asset transaction tax.

entries.headline: Coinbase CEO: 'remarkably bad — will kill jobs'
entries.summary: Brian Armstrong criticized the Illinois crypto tax, calling it 'remarkably bad' and warning it will push innovation out of the state.

entries.headline: Pritzker signs SB 3019 — Digital Asset Tax Act becomes law
entries.summary: Governor JB Pritzker signed the omnibus budget bill including the 0.2% digital asset transaction tax, effective January 1, 2027.
